compact_diagnosis.identity: U=L^-1 Z, Y=L^-1 W, H=I+UU^T=CC^T, P=C^-1; L+=LC and Aw+=P(Aw+UY^T)P^T
compact_diagnosis.operator_dense_sweep_explanation: rank-k correction plus fused direct left and right compact applications; no dense transpose/copy pass
compact_diagnosis.semiseparable_inverse: P_ii=1/d_i and P_ij=-q_i^T u_j for j<i

confirmation_protocol.compact_backend: fused C++ left recurrence and direct C++ right recurrence without dense transpose/copy passes
confirmation_protocol.correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky factorization and double-sided whitening for the same G+ZZ^T and M+ZW^T.
confirmation_protocol.objective: Confirm the exact compact rank-k CPU implementation with fused direct left/right applications against fresh refactorization using multi-seed, exclusive-node, single-thread timing.

pilot_context.selection_result: passed before this protocol was frozen: all five correctness checks passed and every development-seed fresh/direct median ratio exceeded 1
pilot_context.selection_rule: Proceed to a fresh full-grid confirmation only if all correctness checks pass and compact-direct is faster than fresh refactorization on every development seed.

confirmation_protocol.primary_estimand: Within-seed fresh-refactorization median divided by compact-direct rank-k median, summarized across the ten seeds.

prior_confirmation.finding_remediated: the former transpose-based compact backend lost only at r=256,k=32

confirmation_protocol.statistical_unit: One independently generated problem seed; repeat-level timings are summarized within seed and are not pseudoreplicated.
confirmation_protocol.stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, k, and seed. Do not tune, filter, stop, or rerun based on confirmation outcomes.
confirmation_protocol.timed_region: Prepared mutable state cloning is outside timing. Compact timing includes two triangular solves, rank-k correction, compact factor construction, factor update, and direct left/right operator applications. Fresh timing includes G and M rank-k updates, Cholesky factorization, and complete double-sided rewhitening.
confirmation_protocol.timing_order: All six method permutations are repeated equally within every seed/rank/k cell.
